title: Privacy Measurement in Tabular Synthetic Data: State of the Art and Future Research Directions
reasoning: The paper explicitly states in Section 7.3 ('Standardizing privacy assessment') that 'Synthetic data privacy is a multifaceted subject encompassing several disciplines such as mathematics, computer science, ethics, policy-making, law, and philosophy.'
